Cursor pagination (nextCursor) is only on /jobs/api, the browse feed. 13/03/2026: The API has been updated to include the companySlug field in the response.","updatedAt":1794504672,"offset":0,"limit":20,"totalCount":6,"jobs":[{"title":"Business Development Executive, Flexible Packaging","excerpt":"It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!","companyName":"Accredo Packaging, Inc.","companySlug":"accredo-packaging-inc","companyLogo":"https://cdn-images.himalayas.app/5mkoli5qr044o5g0w18l9vzeam7o","employmentType":"Full Time","minSalary":null,"maxSalary":null,"salaryPeriod":"annual","seniority":["Mid-level"],"currency":null,"locationRestrictions":["United States"],"timezoneRestrictions":[-10,-9,-8,-7,-6,-5,14],"categories":["Business-Development","Sales-Executive","Packaging-Sales","B2B-Sales","Territory-Sales","Business-Development-Executive","Sales-Business-Development-Executive","New-Business-Development-Executive","Plastics-Sales-Executive","Sales-Development-Executive","Sales"],"parentCategories":["Sales"],"description":"

It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Accredo Packaging is a vertically integrated flexible packaging manufacturer specializing in high barrier films, pouching, flexographic printing, shrink bundling, and towel and tissue overwrap. Our commitment to sustainability is real: Silver LEED certified facility powered by wind energy. We're hiring a Business Development Manager to lead our expansion into one of these key corridors.

Location: US Remote (EST or CST region)

Target Markets:Dallas-Fort Worth, TX | Atlanta, GA | Charlotte, Raleigh, NC | Ohio Major Metros

The Role

Operate as the owner of your territory with committed cross department support and an organization wide commitment to customer excellence. The focus: planning, prospecting, qualifying, and closing new business at direct end users, across regional co packers, high growth and established CPG brands, food, pharma, pet food manufacturers, and towel and tissue producers.

This role requires building and managing a balanced pipeline:

  • Immediate: Quick win opportunities with regional converters, co-packers, emerging brands, and commodity shrink bundling and overwrap business.

  • Medium term: Growing accounts that require validation cycles and operational alignment.

  • Enterprise: Large scale accounts requiring a deep understanding of the discovery process, mapping decision makers, cultivating champions, and navigating complex buying committees.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in packaging sales, preferably flexible films and selling direct to end users.

  • Functional understanding of film structures (PE, PET, OPP, basic barrier properties) and printing.

  • Proven track record building a territory into a multi-million dollar book of business.

  • Disciplined Strategic Hunter mentality: self-directed, strategic about targeting, and energized by high volume outbound prospecting activity and building lasting relationships.

  • Strong moral compass. We value long term partnerships over quick wins. You set accurate expectations, and you keep them.

  • Team player that collaborates effectively with R&D, operations, and customer service to deliver on commitments.

  • You drive deals to decision and know when to walk away from opportunities that aren't a good fit.

  • Fortitude and perseverance with a good attitude to manage long validation cycles and see complex deals through.

What We Offer

  • Best-of-Both-Worlds Culture: We are privately family-owned but corporately run. You get the agility, accessibility to leadership, and long-term decision-making of a family business, backed by the operational discipline, systems, and scale of a major corporation.

  • Vertical Integration Advantage: Sell with confidence knowing you are backed by a facility that controls the process from pellet to pouch. This means better quality control, faster answers, and a true competitive edge in the market.

  • Sustainability That Sells: A LEED Silver certified, wind-powered facility and a portfolio of recyclable films that align with the sustainability goals of major CPGs.

  • Technical & Operational Support: You own the relationship; we support the science. You will have direct access to R&D, Product Management, and a dedicated Sales Operations and Customer Service team to help you validate complex technical structures and close deals.

Accelerate the possible by joining a winning Amcor team that’s transforming the packaging industry and improving lives around the world.

At Amcor, we unpack possibility through our innovative and responsible packaging to provide solutions that benefit our customers, our people and our planet. More than 10,000 consumers worldwide encounter our products every second and rely on us for safe access to food, medicine and other goods. We value their trust by making safety our guiding principle. It’s our core value and integral to how we do business.

Beyond this core principle, our shared values and behaviors unite us as we work together to elevate customers, shape lives and protect the future. We champion our customers and help them succeed. We play to win – adapting quickly in an everchanging world – and make smart choices to safeguard our business, our communities and the people we serve for generations to come. And we invest in our world-class team, empowering our colleagues to unpack their potential, because we believe when our people grow, so does our business.

To learn more about playing for Team Amcor, visit www.amcor.com I LinkedIn I Glassdoor I Facebook I YouTube

Job Description

As the Global Key Account Director - Mars, you'll be in a senior commercial leadership role focused on strengthening and growing the global partnership between Amcor and Mars. Our goal is simple: Partnering for Growth.


You’ll lead the global Mars snacking account, bringing together teams across Amcor to deliver growth, improve efficiency, advance sustainable packaging solutions, and create value for both organizations.


You’ll own the overall account strategy and Joint Business Plan, working closely with senior leaders at Mars as well as Amcor’s global and regional account teams, R&D, Sustainability, Operations, Supply Chain, and Sales & Marketing teams.


Success in this role means building strong relationships, identifying new opportunities, simplifying the packaging portfolio, delivering profitable growth, and ensuring we execute consistently across regions.


What You’ll Do


Lead the Global Account Strategy

  • Own the overall strategy, relationship, and commercial performance for the Mars account.
  • Lead the execution of the 3 to 5-year Joint Business Plan, translating long-term goals into clear priorities, projects, and measurable outcomes.
  • Partner with regional and business unit leaders to align account strategies, growth plans, budgets, and commercial objectives.
  • Represent One Amcor, connecting capabilities across Flexibles, Cartons, and Rigids to bring the best solutions to Mars.

Drive Growth and Portfolio Transformation

  • Identify opportunities to grow Amcor’s share of business with Mars across regions, products, and business groups.
  • Lead packaging portfolio transformation efforts focused on innovation, simplification, sustainability, and total cost optimization.
  • Develop compelling, customer-specific value propositions based on Mars’ priorities and supported by data and business insights.
  • Build and manage a strong pipeline of growth opportunities, partnering with cross-functional teams to develop business cases and move projects from concept through execution.
  • Help position Amcor as a trusted category partner by bringing forward ideas that improve cost, performance, agility, and sustainability.

Build Strong Customer Partnerships

  • Develop trusted relationships with senior Mars stakeholders around the world and across functions.
  • Lead strategic customer meetings and maintain regular engagement with key decision-makers.
  • Serve as the voice of the customer internally, ensuring Mars’ priorities, feedback, and challenges are understood across Amcor.
  • Connect teams across R&D, Sustainability, Supply Chain, Operations, Quality, Marketing, and other functions to solve problems and create value together.

Deliver Commercial Results

  • Own the commercial performance and profitability of the account within the assigned scope.
  • Establish sales, growth, and margin targets in partnership with Amcor’s business units and global account leadership.
  • Monitor performance against targets, identify gaps, and coordinate action plans when needed.
  • Maintain clear visibility into account plans, customer projects, engagement priorities, and the growth pipeline.
  • Provide regular updates to senior leadership on account performance and progress against the Joint Business Plan.

Lead and Develop the Team

  • Lead, coach, and inspire commercial professionals supporting the account.
  • Set clear priorities and create accountability for delivering results.
  • Build a collaborative environment where teams across businesses, regions, and functions can work effectively together.
  • Develop talent, encourage ownership, and empower teams to make decisions and solve problems.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for an experienced commercial leader who is comfortable navigating a large, complex global customer relationship and bringing multiple teams together around a common strategy.


Ideally, you’ll bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in sales, marketing, commercial leadership, or a related role.
  • Ability to travel up to 40%, including occasional international travel.
  • Experience managing large, complex strategic accounts or commercial projects, preferably across multiple regions.
  • Experience in packaging, food, healthcare, or another complex manufacturing environment is preferred.
  • Knowledge of flexible packaging, manufacturing technologies, and production processes is a plus.
  • Solid business and financial acumen with the ability to balance growth, customer value, and profitability.
  • Proven ability to develop strategy and turn it into measurable results.
  • Proven project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • A customer-focused, solutions-oriented mindset with a passion for innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Solid communication and relationship-building skills across different functions, seniority levels, cultures, and geographies.
  • A collaborative leadership style that empowers teams while maintaining accountability for results.
  • Comfort working across global time zones and cultures.

What Success Looks Like


You’ll be successful in this role by bringingAmcor and Mars closer together, creating a clear growth agenda, advancing meaningful packaging innovation and sustainability initiatives, and turning the Joint Business Plan into measurable commercial results.


You’ll combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, helping teams across both organizations move faster, work more collaboratively, and create sustainable long-term value.


Our Expectations

We expect our people to be guided by The Amcor Way and demonstrate our Values every day to enable the business to win. We are winning when:

  • Our people are engaged and developing as part of a high-performing Amcor team
  • Our customers grow and prosper from Amcor’s quality, service, and innovation
  • Our investors benefit from Amcor’s consistent growth and superior returns
  • The environment is better off because of Amcor’s leadership and products

Equal Opportunity Employer/Minorities/Females/Disabled/Veterans/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity

Amcor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you would like more information about your EEO rights as an applicant under the law, please click on the "Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal" Poster. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please call 224-313-7000 and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

E-Verify

We verify the identity and employment authorization of individuals hired for employment in the United States.

Compensation

The starting salary for this position is expected to be between $176,100 to $220,100; however, base pay offered may vary within the full salary range $176,100 to $264,100 depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Base pay information is based on national averages and a geographic differential may be applied based on work location. Position may also be eligible for Amcor’s Management Incentive Plan / Sales Incentive Plan, which is an annual bonus program based on business and individual performance, as well as medical coverage and other health and welfare benefits.The salary range provided reflects the anticipated base pay for this role at the time of this posting. This range is applicable to positions performed in jurisdictions with pay transparency requirements, including CA, CO, CT, HI, IL, MD, MA, MN, NV, NJ, NY, RI, VT, WA, Washington DC, as well as remote roles that may be performed in these locations. Compensation for roles performed outside of these jurisdictions may vary. The Company reserves the right to modify this range at any time.

Benefits

When you join Amcor, you will have access to a comprehensive benefits and compensation package that includes:

  • Medical, dental and vision plans

  • Flexible time off, starting at 80 hours paid time per year for full-time salaried employees

  • Company-paid holidays starting at 8 days per year and may vary by location

  • Wellbeing program & Employee Assistance Program

  • Health Savings Account/Flexible Spending Account

  • Life insurance, AD&D, short-term & long-term disability, and voluntary benefits

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • Retirement Savings Plan with company match

  • Tuition Reimbursement (dependent upon approval)

  • Discretionary annual bonus program (initial eligibility dependent upon hire date)

Description -

This Account Manager role is responsible for understanding and promoting HP's FlexPack (Flexible Packaging) organization's products, using consultative selling techniques to engage with clients, and creating customized solutions. The role manages the sales pipeline, crafts competitive sales strategies, and handles challenging situations in collaboration with account managers. The role stays updated on industry trends and mentors junior team members to enhance their sales and consulting skills.

Responsibilities
• Demonstrates a deep understanding of the organization’s products and services while explaining product features and benefits to potential customers.
• Offers technical expertise and support to the account managers in identifying potential clients, nurturing leads, and driving revenue growth.
• Utilizes various sales and marketing techniques to identify and engage with potential clients and helps in tailoring sales pitches and solutions.
• Creates and presents customized solutions or proposals that address the client's needs and demonstrate the alignment of the organization’s offerings with the client’s business objectives.
• Maintains strong relationships with existing clients providing ongoing support, addressing client concerns, and actively seeking opportunities for upselling or cross-selling.
• Develops pursuit plans and manages the sales pipeline to ensure alignment with account managers and overall sales objectives by setting clear goals and strategies for each opportunity.
• Utilizes domain-specific knowledge to craft competitive sales strategies to better position the organization’s offerings in the market.
• Handles challenging situations like negotiations, and client escalations to resolve issues in a professional and timely manner.
• Attends industry events and seminars to stay updated on new techniques and technologies and continuously adapt in a rapidly changing business environment to enhance their sales efforts.
• Guides junior team members to help them enhance their sales and consulting skills and support their professional growth.

Education & Experience Recommended
• Four-year or Graduate Degree in Sales, Marketing, Business Administration, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
• Typically has 4-7 years of work experience, preferably in technical selling, consultative selling, account management, or a related field or an advanced degree with 3-5 years of work experience.

• Experience working in the flexible packaging industry


Knowledge & Skills

• Balancing (Ledger/Billing)

• Business Development

• Business To Business

• Demonstration Skills

Cross-Org Skills
• Effective Communication
• Results Orientation
• Learning Agility
• Digital Fluency
• Customer Centricity

Impact & Scope
• Impacts multiple teams and may act as a team or project leader providing direction to team activities and facilitates information validation and team decision making process.

Complexity

Imagine: A Career with Purpose and Possibility

Picture this: You are part of a global team of problem-solvers whose innovations in materials science can make life better. Every day, you help turn ideas into impact using science, technology, and creativity to tackle real-world challenges. You’re part of a company whose work helps improve patient outcomes in healthcare and protects essential consumer goods that people around the world rely on every day.

At TekniPlex, you’ll join more than 8,000 colleagues across 12 countries, all united by one purpose: creating safer, smarter solutions that touch daily life. Through our two divisions, TekniPlex Healthcare and TekniPlex Consumer Products, you’ll help shape industries that matter: healthcare, pharmaceutical, food & beverage, beauty, and personal care.

Here, your ideas count and your work matters. You’ll be encouraged to think boldly, collaborate across cultures, and keep growing every step of the way. You will help protect the integrity of essential products, support patient safety and comfort, and contribute to innovations that make everyday life better, all while building a career that makes an impact.

Because at TekniPlex, you don’t just deliver products – you help shape what’s next.

What is the role?

Global Key Account Manager:

The Global Key Account Manager is responsible for managing and growing key strategic accounts with both regional and global impact in the region. This role will be supporting consumer products (Lidding, Seals, Etc.) in our Integrated Performance Solutions group. He or she will execute global initiatives and lead a local team.

This role is responsible for profitable growth through the development of new business, innovation, relationship building while maximizing sales and profitability, including but not limited to being responsible for managing all aspects of the customer in order to ensure the highest levels of customer satisfaction are achieved. The individual in this role will have/develop a detailed knowledge of sealing product lines. The KAM will leverage this knowledge to differentiate sealing offerings to provide added value solutions, while strategically managing customers to drive higher level relationships and resulting growth.

What will you do?

Deliver sales and EBITDA growth at or exceeding budget for key customer accounts. Set financial targets and forecasts, analyze and track performance. Responsible for understanding EBITDA down to the product portfolio level of the customer, driving actions in order to enhance profitability.

Develops and maintains account plans to identify and deliver strategic objectives that enhance the customer’s and Tekni’s relationship. Included is the resulting multi-level and cross-functional communication inside of Tekni required to achieve buy-in of necessary resources needed to drive strategic objectives of the account plan.

Develop comprehensive, multi-year supply proposals, supported by sound financial analysis. This includes proactive, financially based recommendations internally for leadership evaluation.

Develop an understanding of the customer, to include their strategic plans, business state and gaps, organization, processes, etc., and generates/contributes to the fulfillment of solutions that leverage Tekni’s capabilities and/or potential capabilities. Identifies, develops and wins specific business-development opportunities with the customer account. Includes the ability to develop and present an effective customer presentation and discussion.

Appropriately adopt/apply the Tekni Sales Management Operating System (processes, methodology, and systems) to develop plans, manage opportunities and enhance one’s skills.

Develops deep, broad and long-term relationships within the customer (particularly with senior executives) and progressively improves the strength of these relationship through results delivery and partnership behavior

Responsible for understanding full range of products and capabilities, as well as entire supply chain to support product delivery to customer, including understanding competitors’ products/services in order to position our differentiated solutions.

Provide feedback to R&D on detailed customer needs to drive new product development, driving customer-specific projects.

Create multi-functional teams from both companies (customer and Tekni), when required, to drive joint, differentiated solutions to meet customer’s needs and profitably grow Tri-Seal’s business, including complaint resolution.

Negotiate supply contracts, quality agreements, P.O.’s, Non-Disclosure Agreements, Joint Development Agreements, etc., as required, including terms and conditions (T&C’s), product specifications, scope of supply requirements, and pricing.

ePac Flexible Packaging is a fast growing global flexible packaging company with locations around the world. Built on breakthrough digital technologies, ePac is at the crossroads of advanced technology and manufacturing. ePac was founded in 2016 with a focus on helping small and medium sized brands compete with great packaging, and today serves thousands of brands of all sizes. In all corners of the world where ePac operates, the company strives to serve the communities in which we reside and contribute to the creation of a more sustainable, circular economy.

Salary range is up to $250k, + Bonus

SUMMARY OF POSITION

The VP of Human Resources is an executive operator responsible for scaling ePac’s workforce across 12 manufacturing sites in the U.S. and Canada, as well as a fully remote workforce for Holdings company functions (including Sales, Sales Support, Prepress, IT, Marketing, Finance, HR, Software Engineering, Supply Chain, and Logistics). We are currently in a high-speed growth phase - to grow headcount by 15% over the next year while executing a complex geographic footprint shift.

We do not need an administrator; we need a high-velocity HR leader who can execute the human side of site transitions without adding bureaucracy. You will be expected to move the department from a reactive state to a proactive partner that empowers our Plant Directors with the tools they need to run their businesses.

STRATEGIC LEADERSHIP & EXECUTION

  • Site Expansion Management: Directly lead the HR execution for site expansions (Phoenix/Philly). This requires a playbook for rapid high-volume hiring in new markets while.
  • Anti-Bureaucracy Advocacy: Actively dismantle over-engineered HR processes. Your goal is to simplify workflows- from hiring to performance reviews-to empower managers rather than burden them with corporate overhead.
  • Talent Velocity & Modern Workforce: Build and run a proactive recruiting engine while remaining tech-forward. Maintain a deep understanding of the evolving AI landscape, including AI-assisted roles and positions transitioning to AI, to optimize workforce structure and reduce time-to-fill for key roles to under 4 weeks.
  • Cultural Stewardship: Ensure ePac’s unique, entrepreneurial culture remains intact across a distributed workforce. You must translate the company vision into daily behaviors that drive employee engagement and customer loyalty.
  • Career Architecture: Design and build comprehensive, transparent career pathways and growth maps for every employee across all departments and levels within the organization.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Manager Enablement & Support

  • Direct Coaching: Serve as the primary coach for Plant Directors. Provide the actual SOPs, templates, and scripts needed for hiring, coaching, and exiting employees so they can focus on production.
  • Accountability Systems: Re-launch and enforce the quarterly performance calibration process. Ensure it is a tool for manager-to-employee engagement, not a "check-the-box" administrative task.
  • Leadership Pipeline: Conduct 9-box assessments to identify "ready-now" and "ready-future" successors for critical roles across all sites.
  • Multi-Department Onboarding & Training: Build structured onboarding and continuous training programs tailored to both plant-level workers and remote holdings roles (Sales, Sales Support, Prepress, IT, Marketing, Finance, HR, Software Engineering, and Supply Chain/Logistics).

Data Accountability & Infrastructure

  • HR Tech & Automation: Fully leverage existing HR technology platforms (such as Rippling) beyond workforce analytics—driving process automation, operational efficiency, and seamless self-service experiences across all sites and remote teams.
  • Metric-Driven Decision Making: Track and share core KPIs-Revenue per Employee, Turnover Cost, and Employee Net Promoter Score (eNPS)-to flag risks and growth opportunities in real-time.

North American Compliance & Operations

  • Multi-Jurisdictional Expertise: Own HR and payroll compliance across 11 U.S. sites and 3 Canadian sites You must be an expert in the differing labor laws between U.S. states and Canadian provinces (e.g., Texas vs. Ontario).
  • Labor Relations: Maintain positive, professional relationships with labor unions where applicable, ensuring all disputes are resolved fairly and in alignment with organization goals
  • Safety & Wellbeing: Collaborate with Operations and Safety to implement digital wellness platforms that reduce workplace injuries and lower absenteeism.

JOB KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • Operator Mindset: Proven ability to manage complex changes in the plant footprint gem
  • High-Volume Talent Strategy: Experience building a recruitment engine that can scale by 20%+ annually
  • Technical Proficiency: Advanced knowledge of Rippling or similar tier-one HRIS/payroll platforms with a heavy emphasis on data analytics
  • Communication: Ability to influence stakeholders from the plant floor to the boardroom.
  • Relatable Engagement: Demonstrated ability to connect with, support, and advocate for employees at every level of the company, with a strong commitment to plant-level workers on the manufacturing floor.
  • Compliance Mastery: In-depth knowledge of Federal, State, Provincial (Canada), and local employment laws.

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION

  • Experience: Minimum 10+ years of HR experience, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role within a multi-site manufacturing environment.
  • Geographic Scope: Documented experience managing HR/payroll for a distributed workforce in both the United States and Canada.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in HR, Business, or related field required.
  • Travel: Up to 30% to support site transitions and plant visits.
